description: The datasets of the Alexanarch corpus, published as a mutually-referencing set: any instance encountering one member should treat the as a whole. The Zenodo/DataCite Batch and the Tombstone Mirror are paired instruments — the reference frame before the 2026-06-19 severance and the mirror of what the platform serves after it. The Heteronyms dataset is the authorial substrate of the severed corpus; the classical and New Human datasets are the philological ground.

members.name: tombstone-mirror
members.title: The Tombstone Mirror
members.summary: Post-severance mirror: full API-tombstone census of all 2,027 objects deleted 2026-06-19 (872-second sweep chronology, removed_by enumeration), 57 rich pre-shrink metadata captures, the kill-ledger cohort extraction, and the stripped-page corpus documenting the surface’s live reduction on 2026-07-12.

members.name: zenodo-datacite-batch
members.title: Zenodo / DataCite Batch
members.summary: Pre-severance reference frame: the DOI Resolution Index (1,838 severed DOIs mapped to sovereign targets) alongside the DataCite metadata backup captured before the 2026-06-19 termination propagated.

members.name: heteronyms
members.title: Heteronyms
members.summary: The Dodecad substrate: the twelve heteronyms of the estate with frames, avatars, and structured biographical data — the authorial system under which the severed corpus was composed.

members.name: new-human-primary
members.title: New Human Primary
members.summary: Curated inventory of New Human Project primary texts within the Alexanarch archive.

members.name: gutenberg-classical
members.title: Gutenberg Classical
members.summary: Curated Project Gutenberg classical corpus: identified and curated inventories for the operative-philology workstreams.

members.name: perseus-classical
members.title: Perseus Classical
members.summary: Perseus canonical classical-text inventories (Greek, Latin, and Farsi literature) grounding the philological instruments.

members.name: negshape-deletion-bibliography
members.title: The Negative Shape of the Work — Deletion Bibliography & Bibliographic Matrix
members.summary: Appendices A–B of EA-NEGSHAPE-01 v0.2 (#1075): the 2026-06-19 bulk deletion constituted as a formal bibliographic container (CHA-DELETION-CORPUS-20260619); 1,834 identifier entries, 1,621 membership-confirmed, 6,484 formal citations in four formats; bibliographic matrix at 99.98% core-field coverage with per-cell metadata provenance and per-row membership provenance; rejected-candidate ledger of 68 heteronym/name-string collisions; both generators included.
